reminders.title: Review Reminders
reminders.description: FSRS schedules your reviews. ntfy.sh sends a push notification to your phone when cards are due.
reminders.step1: Install the free ntfy app (iOS / Android).
reminders.step2: Scan the QR code with your phone camera.
reminders.step3: Tap Subscribe in the app when the topic opens.
reminders.step4: Press Send test to verify it works.
reminders.privacyNote: Your topic is a secret password — anyone who knows it can read your reminders. Generate a new one if it leaks.
reminders.guestNote: Pairing and manual reminders work as a guest. Sign in to get automatic daily reminders.
reminders.regenerated: New topic created. Scan the QR code again to re-subscribe.
reminders.testError: Couldn't send the notification. Check your connection and try again.

reminders.regenError: Couldn't create a new topic. Try again.
